Hi Samira,

Thanks — received. Quick clarification needed before we clear the PO: the W-9 you submitted shows a DBA on line 2 and a legal name on line 1, but Accounts Payable's name-match validation flagged the EIN/name combination as not matching our internal IRS vendor table. To avoid 1099 classification/backup withholding issues we need one of the following:

- an IRS EIN verification letter (147C) that confirms the EIN and legal name, or
- an updated W-9 where the legal name exactly matches the name the EIN is registered under, or
- a notarized affidavit linking the DBA to the legal entity plus a bank verification letter that references the EIN.

I put the PO on hold pending receipt of one of the above. Can you let us know which you can provide and an ETA? Looping in Priyom from Procurement to help with timelines.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Hi Sean,

Appreciate the flag. We can provide the IRS 147C but that will take 5–7 business days to request and receive from our tax advisor. In the meantime we attached a bank verification letter that includes our legal entity name and EIN and a notarized affidavit that ties the DBA to Kestrel Labs Inc. — the documents are intended to bridge the gap while the 147C is processed.

Attachments: Notarized_Affidavit.pdf, Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf

Let me know if those are sufficient to unblock the PO temporarily. If you need the 147C we will prioritize the request.

Regards,
Samira

Subject: Re: New vendor submission — W-9 + onboarding form (Kestrel Labs / DBA Kestrel Innovations)

Samira / Sean — quick procurement note:

Thanks for the materials. Our vendor validation checklist requires documentation that ties the EIN to the legal name before we move a vendor into the active vendor pool for >$50k annual spend commitments. For low-risk/one-off PO amounts we sometimes allow a conditional PO with the following controls:

- PO flagged as "conditional: tax verification pending" in the system
- payment net terms set to 30 days after receipt of 147C or Updated_W-9_signed.pdf
- a finance hold tag that prevents auto-renewal of any recurring purchase orders

Please confirm the anticipated PO value for this initial order and whether Kestrel is agreeable to these temporary controls. If yes, we can issue a conditional PO (number will include "COND") to avoid delaying urgent work.

Priyom Das
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
